contracts.requirement: Affine mapping: [a,b,c,d,tx,ty] gives x'=a*x+c*y+tx; y'=b*x+d*y+ty. Reference inputs/outputs are finite; each case defines absolute and relative tolerances.
Serialize finite technical SVG numbers with invariant decimal points; localized visible labels are separate.
Preserve Unicode user text and XML-escape it for the correct SVG text/attribute context.
Graphics core is UI/game independent. Math core does not depend on Graphics; concrete Math integration remains proposed ADR-GFX-003.
